meta.note: One places dataset for every map on the Kohlmann site; the engine Family Map reads it. Every place here is drawn. Living people are on the map like anyone else, at the family's wish (Sebastian Belfiore, 26 November 2026). Leads are drawn as "no proven link". Business associates of the family firm are drawn as "Business associate. Not family". Places that could not be placed are listed on the map page tray and in the project notes, not here. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim, 26 November 2026.

places.name: Singwitz
places.blurb: The letterhead places the factory on the Industriegelände Singwitz, south of Bautzen. Only the village is known, so the circle marks Singwitz. The Industriegelände Singwitz was the set of buildings of the former Royal Saxon powder factory, let to firms from 1920 after the factory closed in 1919.

events.summary: Ernst Alwin Eifler: factory at Singwitz, 1943
events.note: 1943 is the year of the surviving invoice. The letterhead names the factory estate.

places.name: Gnaschwitz
places.blurb: The 1928 address book calls the firm "Matratzenfabrik Gnaschwitz". The letterhead names a private rail siding at the Gnaschwitz works railway. The works railway of 1916 ran from Großdöbschütz through Singwitz to the old Gnaschwitz powder factory. Only the village is known, so the circle marks Gnaschwitz.

places.name: Neusalzaer Straße 38 (Hinterhaus), Bautzen
places.blurb: Alwin Eifler's home and the firm's office and shop (Kontor und Verkaufsstelle), in the rear building. The Ancestry index of the 1932 book reads No. 36, next door; the SLUB copy reads No. 38. From 1929 the firm's shop was at An den Fleischbänken 7; its telephone 2512 was Alwin Eifler's own number at Martin-Mutschmann-Straße 19 in 1935.

places.name: Kötzschau near Lawalde
places.blurb: Lead only. Ernst Alwin Kohlmann, the Bautzen butcher, was born here on 21 September 1883. Kötzschau is a hamlet of Kleindehsa in the parish of Lawalde, near Löbau; his birth was registered at Lawalde. He may be Alvin Kohlmann's father. Not proven. Ernestine Hedwig Kohlmann, probably his sister, was born in Kleindehsa, the same village, in 1897.
